2. Description of Incident

Employee was drilling metal on the job site and had his left ear uncovered at the time of the incident. Metal particles dislodged during the drilling operation and entered his left ear canal, causing irritation and discomfort. Employee reported the incident and was transported to the clinic for evaluation.

3. Medical Treatment & Diagnosis

Treating FacilityNorth Houston – Occucare International
15621 Blue Ash Dr, Houston, TX 77090-5819
Phone: 713-802-0801
Treating PhysicianD.P. Gonzalez, MD
APRNJohn Ngene, NP — License #AP116408
DiagnosisIrritation of tympanic membrane of left ear (ICD-10: H73.92)
Visit TypeInitial Visit
Discharge Time1:31 PM — June 12, 2026

The doctor examined Alan's left ear and determined that no foreign objects (metal particles) were found inside the ear canal. The tympanic membrane (eardrum) was found to be swollen and irritated as a result of the incident.


Recommended Treatment: Employee was advised to use Debrox (over-the-counter ear drops) — 3 drops, at least 3 times per day. Debrox helps clean the ear canal and reduce swelling and irritation.


Follow-up: No further medical care is anticipated at this time. No follow-up appointment scheduled.
